newsitem.title: USA: Demeter gets patent for wound treatment.
newsitem.headline: Demeter gets patent for wound treatment.

text.p: Demeter BioTechnologies Ltd, which designs and develops synthetic molecules for anti-infective and anti-cancer usage, said on Wednesday it was awarded a U.S. patent for its treatment to help wounds heal.
The patent was called "Method of Enhancing Wound Healing by Stimulating Fibroblast and Keratinocyte Growth In Vivo, Utilizing Amphipathic Peptides."
The company said the patent covered some Demeter peptides or small proteins, which killed dangerous bacteria while accelerating the growth of certain dermal cells involved in healing skin tissue.
The patent also covered other claims for using these peptides in the production and application of skin grafts for burn and surgical wounds, it said.
